uncited: *   **Sub-pixel level ($L$):** An integer controlling detail and flicker reduction.
This causes flicker (yuragi) when frames are switched rapidly.

*   **Density Variation Artifacts:** Assuming uniform density within a tetrahedron using the centroid value may cause artifacts at cell boundaries if the density varies significantly or the aspect ratio is high.
*   **Discretization Error:** Projected particles are discretized to sub-pixel positions.
*   **Time Complexity:** Linear with respect to the number of tetrahedral cells and the number of generated particles.
The method does not require storing all cell data in memory or sorting cells along the view ray.
*   **History:** Previous PBVR methods used Metropolis sampling with opacity as energy, leading to non-unique images dependent on user-specified particle counts.
